_about: My audit of the demo, by hand. summary: all 16 rows of the capture's AUDIT.md (12 kept sentences, then the 4 set aside), each with two verdicts: line = does the one transcript line at the sentence's timestamp support it (null where the app gives no timestamp), transcript = does anything in the transcript support it. asks: all 16 questions of ASK-BANK.md: answerable = does the meeting answer it; verdict = was the app's reply right; label and note where the copy deck has them; invented = the answer adds a word nobody said. Every entry is keyed by sha256, the SHA-256 of the exact app string it describes (build_demo.key_of: a sentence's text; for an exchange, build_demo.ask_string). A new capture with different words fails the build until the entry is re-audited. excerpt is for a human reader only. The scoreboard on the home page is counted from these fields and never typed.

captions.typed: It was asked 16 questions about this meeting, and those are the only answers I can show you. I won't write a 17th for it. Pick one, or email me what you'd have asked: support@meringo.app.

the other {linePartly} land on a line that says only part of it
{keptPartly} of {kept} kept sentences are only partly supported by the transcript
{trapsRefused} of {traps} questions the meeting doesn't answer, or answers only in part: refused
{invented} answer adds a word nobody said
